The '''Republic Alcove Camp''' was a military outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established in the vicinity of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Revanite crisis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Alcove Camp appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
